$comment: Single source for how skills are grouped and summarised. Used by `securitykit skills`, /sk-help and README.md (regenerate with: python tools/gen_catalog_docs.py). Every skills/sk-* folder must appear exactly once. Summaries: one line, at most 90 characters.

groups.title: Workflows
groups.blurb: Start here: whole-project audits, everyday change reviews, and fixing what was found.

skills.name: sk-help
skills.summary: List every SecurityKit command, grouped, with a one-line description

skills.name: sk-audit
skills.summary: Run every relevant skill and produce one combined, deduplicated report and score

skills.name: sk-review
skills.summary: Fast security review of the current diff, branch or PR only

skills.name: sk-fix
skills.summary: Work through findings from any report, applying approved fixes with re-verification

groups.title: APIs
groups.blurb: HTTP, REST, GraphQL, gRPC, real-time and webhook surfaces, and the contracts that describe them.

skills.name: sk-api
skills.summary: API audit: auth and ownership on every endpoint, errors, validation, missing tests

skills.name: sk-rest
skills.summary: REST baseline: HTTPS, methods, content types, size limits, headers, CORS, errors

skills.name: sk-graphql
skills.summary: GraphQL: introspection, depth/cost limits, batching, field-level authorization

skills.name: sk-openapi
skills.summary: OpenAPI/Swagger spec vs code: undocumented and stale endpoints, auth mismatches

skills.name: sk-webhooks
skills.summary: Webhooks received (signatures, replay) and sent (SSRF, signing)

skills.name: sk-websocket
skills.summary: WebSockets, SSE and real-time: handshake auth, Origin, channel authorization, limits

skills.name: sk-grpc
skills.summary: gRPC: TLS, auth interceptors, per-method authorization, reflection, limits, deadlines

groups.title: Identity & access
groups.blurb: Who the user is, how they prove it, and what they are allowed to do.

skills.name: sk-auth
skills.summary: Login, sessions, MFA, enumeration, brute force, account recovery, SSO linking

skills.name: sk-password
skills.summary: Password hashing parameters, policy, change and reset flows, credential stuffing

skills.name: sk-tokens
skills.summary: JWT verification, token randomness and storage, refresh rotation, API keys

skills.name: sk-oauth2
skills.summary: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC: PKCE, state, redirect URIs, ID tokens, audiences, scopes

skills.name: sk-saml
skills.summary: SAML SSO: signature checks and wrapping, audience, replay, certificates, RelayState

skills.name: sk-authz
skills.summary: Access-control design: default deny, roles, tenant isolation, IDOR, escalation

groups.title: Injection & untrusted input
groups.blurb: Every place user data reaches an interpreter, a browser, a URL fetcher or a parser.

skills.name: sk-validation
skills.summary: Input validation: schemas, mass assignment, type confusion, ranges, allow-lists

skills.name: sk-inject
skills.summary: All injection: SQL, NoSQL, command, code, SSTI, LDAP, XPath, XXE, header, log

skills.name: sk-xss
skills.summary: Cross-site scripting: DOM sinks, escaping bypasses, sanitizers, CSP

skills.name: sk-ssrf
skills.summary: Server-side request forgery: URL fetches, private IPs, DNS rebinding, cloud metadata

skills.name: sk-redirect
skills.summary: Open redirects: next/returnUrl parameters, bypassable validation, login flows

skills.name: sk-deserialize
skills.summary: Unsafe deserialization (pickle, YAML, Java/.NET/PHP) and prototype pollution

skills.name: sk-upload
skills.summary: File uploads: type checks, names, size, storage, serving, presigned URLs, zip slip

groups.title: Web & browser
groups.blurb: What the browser enforces, what the server tells it, and what caches and configs leak.

skills.name: sk-browser
skills.summary: Security headers, clickjacking, cookie flags, tokens in storage, bundle secrets, SRI

skills.name: sk-csrf
skills.summary: CSRF: disabled protection, state-changing GETs, SameSite, CORS with credentials

skills.name: sk-cache
skills.summary: Caching: personal data cached publicly, cache poisoning and deception, shared keys

skills.name: sk-config
skills.summary: Misconfiguration: debug modes, stack traces, open actuators, fallback secrets

groups.title: Data, privacy & crypto
groups.blurb: Where data lives, who can read it, how it is protected, and what the logs say about it.

skills.name: sk-database
skills.summary: Raw queries, row scoping, DB exposure, TLS, privileges and hardening

skills.name: sk-privacy
skills.summary: Personal data: minimization, exposure, third parties, consent, deletion, retention

skills.name: sk-crypto
skills.summary: Cryptography: algorithms, modes, IVs, keys and KDFs, randomness, TLS verification

skills.name: sk-logging
skills.summary: Security logging: events, audit trails, secrets in logs, alerting, retention

groups.title: Business logic & abuse
groups.blurb: Money, limits, workflows and background work: the bugs scanners alone don't find.

skills.name: sk-business
skills.summary: Business logic abuse: client-set prices, coupon reuse, skipped steps, limits

skills.name: sk-race
skills.summary: Race conditions: double spend, check-then-act, missing locks, idempotency

skills.name: sk-payments
skills.summary: Payments: server-side amounts, webhook verification, refunds, card data scope

skills.name: sk-ratelimit
skills.summary: Rate limits and quotas: login, OTP, expensive endpoints, IP spoofing, bypasses

skills.name: sk-dos
skills.summary: Resource exhaustion: body/page limits, ReDoS, zip bombs, timeouts, unbounded work

skills.name: sk-email
skills.summary: Email and SMS: header injection, poisoned links, spam relays, SMS pumping

skills.name: sk-queue
skills.summary: Queues and jobs: broker auth, unsafe serializers, worker authz, dashboards, DLQs

groups.title: AI & agents
groups.blurb: LLM features, prompt injection, tool-using agents, MCP servers and retrieval.

skills.name: sk-ai
skills.summary: LLM features vs OWASP LLM Top 10: unsafe output, leaks, PII, cost abuse, keys

skills.name: sk-prompt-injection
skills.summary: Prompt injection: untrusted channels, system prompts, tool approvals, outputs

skills.name: sk-agents
skills.summary: Agents and MCP: tool permissions, inputs, sandboxes, human approval, server trust

skills.name: sk-rag
skills.summary: RAG pipelines: poisoning, per-chunk access control, tenant isolation, vector stores

groups.title: Apps & platforms
groups.blurb: Code that runs on users' devices: phones, desktops and browsers.

skills.name: sk-mobile
skills.summary: Android/iOS (MASVS): storage, cleartext, TLS, exported components, WebViews

skills.name: sk-electron
skills.summary: Electron/Tauri: node integration, isolation, preload and IPC, openExternal, updates

skills.name: sk-extension
skills.summary: Browser extensions: permissions, remote code, message senders, content scripts

groups.title: Supply chain & infrastructure
groups.blurb: What ships with the code: dependencies, credentials, containers, clouds, pipelines and domains.

skills.name: sk-secrets
skills.summary: Hardcoded and leaked secrets in code, config, git history, CI and images

skills.name: sk-deps
skills.summary: Dependencies: vulnerabilities, lockfiles, typosquats, confusion, install scripts

skills.name: sk-docker
skills.summary: Dockerfiles, Compose and Kubernetes: root, privileges, mounts, images, secrets

skills.name: sk-cloud
skills.summary: Cloud IaC: public buckets, wildcard IAM, open ports, encryption, IMDSv2, state

skills.name: sk-cicd
skills.summary: CI/CD pipelines: triggers, script injection, token permissions, pinning, runners

skills.name: sk-repo
skills.summary: Repository hygiene: policy, CODEOWNERS, branch protection, tracked secrets, scans

skills.name: sk-domain
skills.summary: Domains and DNS: subdomain takeover, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, CAA, security.txt

groups.title: Design, testing & assurance
groups.blurb: Threat models, tests and scans that prove controls work, and the evidence auditors ask for.

skills.name: sk-design
skills.summary: Threat model: assets, trust boundaries, data flows, STRIDE per component

skills.name: sk-tests
skills.summary: Security test gaps (authn, authz, validation) and generation of the missing tests

skills.name: sk-fuzz
skills.summary: Property-based tests and fuzzing for parsers and input handlers

skills.name: sk-dast
skills.summary: Dynamic scan of a running app you own (OWASP ZAP), with confirmed findings

skills.name: sk-asvs
skills.summary: OWASP ASVS 5.0 coverage map at level 1-3, from all SecurityKit reports

skills.name: sk-compliance
skills.summary: Map findings to SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, HIPAA and GDPR controls

skills.name: sk-incident
skills.summary: Incident readiness: plan, on-call, alerts, revocation, rotation, backups
